prose: |
  buildStageContract emitted inputs.args and inputs.pipeline_output,
  neither of which ethos's strict-decode mission-contract schema
  recognizes (inputs accepts only trigger, files, ticket, and
  references -- confirmed by reading ethos's
  internal/mission/inputs.go knownInputKeys). This made every real
  ClaudeRunner stage mission fail at `ethos mission create` with
  "inputs: unknown field \"args\"".

  Fix: fold call args and the prior stage's pipeline output into the
  top-level context field (a plain string, documented, optional,
  unbounded length) as free text, via a new stageContext helper.
  inputs.trigger is untouched. Args are sorted by key for determinism
  and each value is capped at 500 runes (matching escapeYAMLValue's
  existing cap elsewhere in the package); the pipe value is left
  uncapped since it can be up to 1MB and escapeYAMLPipe -- applied
  once to the whole context string -- is the field meant to carry it.

  Added TestBuildStageContract_ValidatesAgainstRealEthosCLI, which
  writes a contract from buildStageContract to a temp file and calls
  the real `ethos` binary via os/exec (the same mechanism
  createMissionFromContract in mission.go uses), exactly reproducing
  the ClaudeRunner code path. It asserts the CLI call succeeds, parses
  the mission ID with the existing parseMissionID helper, and cleans
  up with `ethos mission abandon` in t.Cleanup. It skips (does not
  fail) when ethos is not on PATH. This is the test that would have
  caught the original bug -- a string-shape or struct assertion on
  buildStageContract's output alone would not have, since the bug was
  ethos's schema rejecting a field, not a Go-side formatting error.

  Also added TestBuildStageContract (parses the generated YAML and
  asserts inputs.args/inputs.pipeline_output are absent while
  inputs.trigger and the new context field carry the expected
  content), TestBuildStageContract_NoArgsNoPipe, TestStageContext
  (table-driven over the free-text formatting, including
  deterministic key ordering), and TestStageContext_LongArgValueCapped
  for the 500-rune cap. No prior tests existed for buildStageContract
  to update -- it had none before this mission, per a direct grep of
  the daemon package's test files.

  make check passes with zero suppressions. Two commits: one for the
  fix and its tests together (single logical step; the fix without
  tests would be an unverified claim).
